description: This is a Java interface defining the contract for managing Permission entities in the system, including methods for retrieving, saving, updating, and deleting permissions based on various criteria.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of permissions filtered by name, details not specified.

methods.name: listPermission
methods.description: Lists all permissions, potentially with exception handling.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a permission entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new permission or updates an existing one.

methods.name: deletePermission
methods.description: Removes a specified permission from the system.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Retrieves permissions associated with a list of group IDs.

methods.name: listByCriteria
methods.description: Lists permissions matching specific criteria defined in PermissionCriteria.

methods.name: removePermission
methods.description: Removes a permission from a specified group.
